report.title: Username Registration Does Not Support Chinese Characters
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.26

### Bug Description

When attempting to register a new username, the system returns an error if the username contains Chinese characters. For example, entering "隧道" (meaning "tunnel") results in the error:
rpc error: code = InvalidArgument desc = invalid username: 隧道  

### Steps to Reproduce

Go to the registration page (or API endpoint).

Enter a username containing Chinese characters (e.g., "隧道").

Submit the registration.

Observe the error.

### Expected Behavior

Usernames containing Chinese characters (or other Unicode characters) should be accepted if the system claims to support international usernames.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_

preconditions: the sign-up page is available and user registration is enabled
steps: Type "隧道" into the username field
plan.expected: No "invalid username" error is shown, and the registration succeeds with the username 隧道 so the user leaves the sign-up page.
plan.reported_actual: Registration fails with the error: rpc error: code = InvalidArgument desc = invalid username: 隧道
missing: assumed: the password "TestPass123!" is acceptable because the report does not give one
assumed: the registration page is the standard sign-up page, not the API endpoint
Is user registration enabled on the instance?
Does the sign-up form have other required fields, such as a confirm-password field?
Does the reporter see the error on the page, such as in a toast, or only through the API?
plan.summary: Sign-up rejects usernames with Chinese characters as 'invalid username'

# Username Registration Does Not Support Chinese Characters

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:16219/auth/signup.
Stay on localhost:16219 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Open the sign-up page
2. Click the username field
3. Type "隧道" into the username field
4. Click the password field
5. Type "TestPass123!" into the password field
6. Click the Sign up button
The reporter says the correct behavior is that No "invalid username" error is shown, and the registration succeeds with the username 隧道 so the user leaves the sign-up page. Verify that No "invalid username" error is shown, and the registration succeeds with the username 隧道 so the user leaves the sign-up page.

verdict.headline: Sign-up rejects the username 隧道 as invalid instead of creating the account.
verdict.root_cause: The sign-up service treats the provided Chinese-character username as invalid, so registration is refused and the user remains on the sign-up page.
verdict.suggested_fix: Update username validation to allow Chinese characters such as 隧道, then confirm that successful registration navigates away from the sign-up page.
